validationNotes.rulingScope: Three full twinpacts and four exact official print images reviewed, no same-name reprints counted. All printed costs, colors, mana orientation, faces and two-player seats tested. Soprano normal blocker/no-player-attack, exact two creature taps and few targets, ordinary non-destruction departures, native optional Last Burst; full actual top-creature/evolution-base/Command-removed-seal QA31778 scenarios. Magma immediate attack, W-breaker, own named spell watcher, ignored/sealed source, mandatory enemy then own breaks even if one side empty; QA31757 complete surviving/departed source including own later named shield trigger; actual encrypted duel service actors and card conservation. Hell Scrapper optional zero/subset and exact5000 budget with actual1000/2000 power cards. Basudaku paid6, hand/grave Mugen Crime3 with distinct physical creatures and3mana, mandatory untapped opposing creature destruction; Ducks exact selected physical unit through next own start, independent other units, external protection even when target ignored and stale same-UID bounce/resummon exclusion. No shared engine behavior changed for1831 beyond engine version; native common rules reused. All older pending items retained and no full npm test or known long group run.
validationNotes.resolvedAttempts: Initial Soprano spec used an unused descriptive lastBurst key instead of actual native g40LastBurst trigger; corrected before verification. Initial fixtures used Meteorzaurus and Dimension Gate instead of actual Spiral Gate/Natural Trap, three2000-power bodies instead of2000+2000+1000, guessed Last Burst action kinds instead of native extended true/null, and allowed AI to use Libribaria Escape instead of explicitly declining. Corrected to actual printed cards, native choices and actual leave-replacement action. Ducks uses existing g565External protection so ignoring creature abilities does not remove the resolved spell effect. All failed raw logs kept; no old pending status changed.
